status: proposed research protocol, not flight authorization or demonstrated performance
purpose: Measure the missing links between externally triggered alerts, thermal confirmation and safe return. Keep recorded-video detection separate from aircraft response experiments.
non_goals: No autonomous fire dispatch or aircraft control from this repository.
No intentionally ignited fires, suppression drops or public emergency-response deployment.
No BVLOS operation until a qualified operator obtains applicable authorization.
No claim that simulator endurance fractions equal measured battery energy.
preconditions: Named qualified operator and site owner approve a site-specific risk assessment, flight limits and abort procedure.
Operator verifies current local airspace, environmental, privacy, insurance and aviation requirements.
Begin with ground replay and then authorized VLOS flights, not a BVLOS fleet demonstration.
Use existing lawfully captured burns or professionally managed events only with organizer permission; do not create burns for this project.
Record aircraft, sensor, firmware, batteries, camera settings and clock synchronization before collection.
Treat vendor maximum endurance and wind ratings as upper limits, never routine planning targets.

stages.name: recorded_data_baseline
stages.split_unit: Entire recording/event and site, not individual frames. Keep adjacent clips from one burn in one split.
annotations: Sample-index fire labels for the existing baseline evaluator, independently reviewed.
Event onset and end, visible flame versus smoke-only, occlusion, altitude and approximate target range.
Source/license, recording group, site/date, sensor modality and train/validation/test designation.
analysis_rules: Freeze thresholds on validation recordings before examining held-out test recordings.
Report raw event counts, exposure hours and uncertainty clustered by recording.
Report flame-visible and smoke-only cases separately; the RGB baseline does not detect smoke.
Define an alarm episode as a maximal contiguous run of sampled alarms; never substitute positive-frame counts for episodes.
Current software reports frame metrics only. Event matching and episode evaluation are not yet implemented.
Failure to meet a target is a research finding, not permission to retune on the test set.

stages.name: authorized_vlos_flight_measurements
conditions: Operator-approved short paths, progressively extended only after measured safe return.
Log outbound, return and crosswind tracks separately; do not deliberately seek high-wind conditions.
Record steady wind and gusts at available sites/altitudes, airspeed, ground speed and actual path length.
Ground target/sensor exercise first; thermal confirmation at a real fire only under separate event authorization.
required_measurements: Alert receipt, operator decision, launch, arrival, confirmed observation, return and ready-again timestamps.
Battery start/end percent, measured energy where available, temperature, health and reserve at landing.
GPS/altitude, trajectory, communications interruptions, gusts, aircraft health and aborts.
External first-alert latency and missed alerts, when ground-truth ignition timing exists.
proposed_acceptance_criteria: 100% of flown missions return within the operator-approved battery and weather envelope.
0 unresolved telemetry/clock gaps on missions included in model calibration.
Report prediction errors for outbound time, return time and ready-again time individually, not only total flight time.
Record all aborts and rejected missions in denominators. Never discard them to improve response statistics.
stop_conditions: Any required authorization, observer, communication link or safe landing option unavailable.
Wind/gust, visibility, reserve, battery temperature or aircraft-health condition reaches the operator's approved abort boundary.
Unexpected persons, aircraft, fire behavior or other hazards enter the operating area.

stages.name: calibrated_network_study
stages.entry_gate: Complete prior stages and lock measured inputs with provenance; flight authorization alone is insufficient.
deliverables: Replace proxy launch/turnaround/endurance and operating costs with measured distributions or quotes.
Use historical local wind, terrain, ignition and upstream alert data with documented spatial/temporal coverage.
Compare external-alert-only and external-alert-plus-drone workflows on confirmation value, missed incidents and cost.
Publish sensitivity and negative results, clearly separated from field measurements and regulatory approvals.

dataset_candidates.name: FLAME 3
dataset_candidates.caution: Verify download terms before acquisition; single-burn imagery cannot establish cross-site generalization.
